TRANSFERANDDISTRIBUTIONOFDEVELOPMENTRIGHTS PURSUANT TOSECTION 98-33(a) OFTHEZONINGRESOLUTIONOFTHECITYOFNEWYORK TRANSFER AND DISTRIBUTION, made as of the 28"h day of March, 2008, by 253-11 80"h Avenue, Glen Oaks, New York 11004 ("Transferor") and 537 WEST 27TH STREET OWNERS LLC, a Delaware limited liability company with an address at 810 Seventh Avenue, 28"h Floor, New York, New York 10019 (*Transferee"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Transferor is the owner in fee of certain land, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York, known as Lot 40 in Block 700 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, and as and by the street address 508 West 29th Street, New York, New York, and more particularly described on Exhibit I annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said real property being hereinafter called the "Transfer Lot"); WHEREAS, the Transfer Lot is currently developed with a five-story building; WHEREAS, Transferor is the owner of the unused floor area and other development rights appurtenant to Transfer Lot; WHEREAS, Transferee is the owner in fee of certain land, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York, known as Lot 9 in Block 699 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, and as and by the street address 537-545 West 27th Street, New York, New York, and more particularly described on Exhibit II annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said property being hereafter called the "Receiving Lot"); WHEREAS, the Transfer Lot is a “granting site,” as defined in Section 98-33 of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York (hereinafter, the “Zoning Resolution"); WHEREAS, the Receiving Lot is a “receiving site,” as defined in Section 98-33 of the Zoning Resolution; WHEREAS, certain “floor area,” as defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution, allowable for the development of the Transfer Lot is unused and is available for transfer under Section 98-30 of the Zoning Resolution; WHEREAS, pursuant to the provisions of Section 98-33 of the Zoning Resolution, the Transferor has notified the City Planning Commission of New York City (hereinafter, the "CPC") of its intent to transfer 5,478.50 square feet of floor area (the “Development Rights") from the Transfer Lot to the Receiving Lot (such notification, hereinafter, the “Notification", is attached hereto as Exhibit III); and WHEREAS, Transferor desires to transfer the Development Rights to the Receiving Lot. NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreement herein contained,it isherebyagreed asfollows: 1. Transferor hereby assigns, transfers, distributes and sets over the Development Rights from the Transfer Lot to the Receiving Lot solely for the use and benefit in perpetuity of the Receiving Lot (and not for the use or benefit of any other lot or parcel of land).  2. Transferor covenants that, in compliance with Section 13 of the Lien Law, it will receive any consideration (if any) paid for such rights as a trust fund and will apply the same first 3. Transferee covenants that it shall not apply for nor seek or cause the issuance of a building permit by the Department of Buildings (the “DOB") for any enlargement or development on the Receiving Lot that would involve use of the Development Rights until it has (i) provided to the New York City Department of City Planning ("DCP") certified copies of (a) a Notice of Zoning Lot Restrictions,and (b) a restrictive declaration,both in forms satisfactory to the DCP, as recorded in the Office of the Register of the City of New York, New York County, and (i) notice by the DCP of its receipt of such copies has been given to the DOB. 4.This Transfer of Development Rights shall be recorded by Transferor against the Transfer Lot and Receiving Lot in the Office of the Register of City of New York, New York County and a copy provided to the CPC in accordance with the provisions of Section 98-33(a) of the ZoningResolution. 5. Transferor covenants to execute and deliver from time to time, upon request by, and at the expense of Transferee or any successorin interest of Transferee,such instruments as are necessary to confirm that the property interest hereby transferred consists of the DevelopmentRightsonlyanddoesnotincludefeeownershipoflandorotherownership interest therein, to liability for real estate taxes, water and sewer charges, or other similar governmental or public utility charges applicable to the Transfer Lot. 2 021254821473124.11C055767
